qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Cost-advantaged integrated pulp and paper mills provide low-cost position in virgin containerboard, but lack pricing power over cyclical swings. Industry capacity additions in Europe led to severe containerboard price cuts, causing ROCE to collapse from 23.7% in 2022 to 12.8% in 2023, 9.6% in 2024, and 6.7% in 2025.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Integrated paper and packaging producer is a cyclical price-taker in containerboard and market pulp; chronic European industry capacity additions and weak demand depressed ROCE to 9.6% in 2024 and 6.7% in 2025.
qualitative.evidence: ROCE dropped from 23.7% in 2022 to 12.8% in 2023, 9.6% in 2024, and 6.7% in 2025 as the post-pandemic packaging boom normalized and massive industry capacity entered the market. Net debt increased to €2.6B (2.6x EBITDA) following the €609M Schumacher acquisition and heavy organic mill capex.
